name: Bronze Nataraja
description: Lost-wax bronze of Shiva as the cosmic dancer, encircled by a ring of flames.

name: Rock Edict Fragment
description: Basalt fragment carrying Brahmi script from an Ashokan edict.

name: Court Scene Miniature
description: Opaque watercolour and gold on paper showing an imperial court assembly.

name: Gold Dinar of Chandragupta II
description: Archer-type gold coin, a hallmark of Gupta-period minting.

name: Paithani Silk Saree
description: Hand-woven silk with zari peacock motifs on the border and pallu.

name: Painted Storage Jar
description: Red-ware jar with black painted pipal-leaf and intersecting-circle patterns.

name: Pata Gauntlet Sword
description: Steel blade fixed to an armoured gauntlet, used by Maratha cavalry.

name: Gita Govinda Palm-leaf Manuscript
description: Incised and inked palm-leaf folios of Jayadeva's Gita Govinda.

name: Kundan Necklace
description: Gold necklace set with uncut gemstones and enamelled (meenakari) reverse.
